name: edit-markup
description: Produce teacher-style markup and clean rewrites of user-authored text such as Quora answers, Substack drafts, essays, and emails. Output is a ruled-paper HTML artifact with two panels: a marked-up version (red strikethroughs for cuts, green highlights for inserts, numbered carets linking to handwriting-style margin notes explaining the reasoning) and a clean final version with a copy button.
